title: 1984 AHSME Problem 8
statement: Figure \(ABCD\) is a trapezoid with \(AB\parallel DC,\) \(AB=5,\) \(BC=3\sqrt2,\) \(\angle BCD=45^\circ\) and \(\angle CDA=60^\circ.\) The length of \(DC\) is

solutions.text: Drop perpendiculars from \(A\) and \(B\) to \(DC.\) Since \(BC=3\sqrt2\) and the angle at \(C\) is \(45^\circ,\) both the height and the right horizontal offset are \(3.\) The left \(30^\circ\)-\(60^\circ\)-\(90^\circ\) triangle has height \(3,\) so its horizontal offset is \(\sqrt3.\) Therefore \[ DC=\sqrt3+AB+3=8+\sqrt3. \] The correct answer is D.
hints: The right-hand triangle is \(45^\circ\)-\(45^\circ\)-\(90^\circ,\) and the left-hand triangle is \(30^\circ\)-\(60^\circ\)-\(90^\circ\)
